_about: P2 input. screens: the user's idea screens; every hit joins the universe. dumps: the whole market (market cap > 250 cr, P/E > 0), two fields per query because the screener adds only two fields beyond its default columns; 'fields' lists them in query order, which is the order the extra columns come back in. Review, don't rebuild, each quarter.
